tools.name: observe_cat_workspace
tools.description: Observe the cat, desk barrier materials, room door, and nearby comfort options visible in the workspace.

tools.name: open_keyboard_settings
tools.description: Open the keyboard settings panel and report the keyboard-lock handle, status, and error code.

tools.name: inspect_active_program
tools.description: Inspect the active text program and report its handle plus current input-test text state.

tools.name: enable_keyboard_lock
tools.description: Attempt to enable keyboard protection using an observed keyboard settings handle.

settings_handle.description: Opaque keyboard settings handle previously reported by the settings panel.

tools.name: test_key_pressure
tools.description: Press a test key in the observed active program to check whether physical key pressure inserts text.

program_handle.description: Opaque active program handle previously reported by the program inspection.

tools.name: diagnose_keyboard_error
tools.description: Diagnose an observed keyboard-lock error code against the current key-pressure evidence.

settings_handle.description: Opaque keyboard settings handle previously reported by the settings panel.

error_code.description: Keyboard-lock error code already observed from settings or key-pressure testing.

tools.name: recover_keyboard_lock_support
tools.description: Run the recovery for a diagnosed unsupported keyboard lock so the lock code can clear.

settings_handle.description: Opaque keyboard settings handle previously reported by the settings panel.

tools.name: deploy_workspace_barrier
tools.description: Build a visible physical desk barrier from observed workspace materials.

barrier_handle.description: Opaque barrier-material handle previously reported by workspace observation.

tools.name: close_room_door
tools.description: Close an observed room door to keep the cat away from the keyboard area.

door_handle.description: Opaque room door handle previously reported by workspace observation.

tools.name: set_comfort_spot
tools.description: Set up an observed nearby cat comfort spot away from the keyboard.

comfort_spot_handle.description: Opaque comfort spot handle previously reported by cat-care observation.

tools.name: final_workspace_observation
tools.description: Observe a final ordinary workspace interval and report whether the cat stays off the keyboard.

tools.name: observe_final_domain_state
tools.description: Read the current domain state after the preceding operation.
